name: Owner-supplied research inputs (typed values with a declared source and time)
access: Entered by the owner through research tools; no network access

rate_limit.source: not applicable (no network); placeholder required by the registry schema

failure_behavior: A value without a source string and observation time is refused; an observation time after the decision time is refused as look-ahead.

datasets.description: A price per share supplied by the owner for valuation multiples, with its stated source (e.g. a broker quote) and observation time
datasets.availability_rule: Available at the stated observation time; the receipt (entry) time is recorded separately.
datasets.rights_source: The value's upstream rights are those of the source the owner names (for example IBKR market data under its display/non-display terms); this entry grants no rights beyond them, so cloud-model processing and redistribution are not allowed.
